uplink.description: Status report: 3.0 V, input0 closed, input1 open
uplink._note: TTN example status report (netvox r311ca codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Volt 3, status1 1, status2 0. byte3 0x1E=30 -> 3.0 V; byte4=1 -> input0 action.contactState 'closed'; byte5=0 -> input1 action.contactState 'open'. Each contact terminal's state is a channels[] entry (input0 = Netvox channel 1); battery stays top-level. Satisfies analog-interface through the entries.

uplink.description: Status report: 3.6 V, input0 open, input1 closed (inverse per-position states)
uplink._note: Synthetic frame in the TTN status-report shape (device id 0x4C), with the two positions in opposite states so the entries cannot be transposed unnoticed. Upstream oracle semantics: status1 = bytes[4] = 0 -> input0 'open'; status2 = bytes[5] = 1 -> input1 'closed' (this family reads non-zero as a closed contact). byte3=36 -> 3.6 V.
